COMPARISON OF 文理生生 (Codex project for Ren, v0.3/v2.2 data) WITH THE THEORY OF BECOMING'S CLASSICAL NAMES (中华本)

Path legend (all read-only; nothing was written or edited):
- WL = /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ren-theories/ab4fc732-b2ac-420a-aa49-cf63c999271c/scratchpad/wenli-data
- ZHW = /Users/ren/theories/_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/zhonghua/work
- CH = /Users/ren/theories/theories/becoming/chapters
- LEAN = /Users/ren/theories/experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming
Note: the 08 JSON is not at WL top level; it is WL/research/references/08_组合文法逐字类型词典_v0.3.json (word-network.json's audit block names that path).

0. METHOD
- Wenli side: WL/research/references/08_组合文法逐字类型词典_v0.3.json (113 core characters / 211 senses, 12 syntax senses on 11 characters, 22 extension senses on 20 characters = 144 characters, 245 senses; "counts" block), WL/08_…v0.3.md, WL/04_逐字动态映射与古文出处_v0.2.md, WL/05_原典证据索引与校勘说明_v0.2.md, WL/data/word-network.json (counts: 144 registered, 245 senses, 132 connections = 54 explicit + 12 construction + 66 expression), WL/research/constructions/constructions.json (12 focused cards CX01–CX12), WL/03 §一–三, WL/18 §一–二, WL/02 第一轮, WL/13 §八.
- Theory side: ZHW/names-decisions.tsv (447 names), ZHW/symbols-not-adopted.tsv (37 declined units), CH/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md §0–§1.5 (read) and grep of the rest, CH/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING-ZHONGHUA.md (序, 凡·三, 凡·十一, 一·三, 六·十六, 七·二, 十二·十四 read), CH/CIVILIZATION-THOUGHT-AND-BECOMING.md (read in full), CH/NONDUAL-METHOD.md (opening sections), LEAN declarations checked by grep.
- Simplification: ZH names simplified with the map in ZHW/simplify.py (its T/S strings and the 21 October additions), extended by 兩→两, 趨→趋; the 447 names stay distinct after simplification.
- Counting was scripted (python3 -I heredocs run from the scratchpad, no file written). Sense comparison per character is my reading (AI): I put each of the 144 wenli characters in exactly one category:
  S = same structure (at least one wenli sense has the structure the ZH name or term names);
  O = overlap (same root structure, different formal role or emphasis);
  D = different structures under the same character;
  NC = ZH declines the character as a name and wenli also keeps it out of the fact/process layer (convergent refusal);
  ND = ZH declines it and wenli gives it a fact or process interface;
  G = function word used in both, with no ZH definition;
  W = wenli only.
  The full lists:
  S (59): 辨序化象名同异相互共自应交分合体位内外爻变成衰消长复静势几机量穷通久终始存续绝息和常证故类宜权刚柔不未则先后求争习毁改
  O (12): 理限物感时度制知法积止力
  D (22): 系形因承界生开闭聚散动往亡中衡节正观察明宇游
  NC (16): 道气性仁义天有无阴阳木火土金水胜
  ND (7): 易德礼信虚反人
  G (6): 而以于为之其
  W (22): 文质实克本末用层兴盛养守坏熄死治乱觉善弱欲学

1. SIZES
- Wenli: 144 characters and 245 senses. By output type the senses are Formula 108, Program 54, ModelDeclaration 30, NormJudgement 20, InterpretationRecord 19, others 14 (08 JSON, counted by script). Every sense is a parametrized interface. Per the 08 md "怎样读这份词典", an interface must be disambiguated, given parameters and bound to a domain before it evaluates. The JSON status line says it is not connected to the executor.
- ZH: 447 names, 193 of them single characters, using 359 distinct characters (names-decisions.tsv). Every name is meant to name one structure anchored to a checked Lean declaration: CIVILIZATION §五·二 rule 3 counts 376 of the 447 names with an anchor recorded. The declined list has 37 units (symbols-not-adopted.tsv).

2. OVERLAP BY CHARACTER (scripted)
- 122 of wenli's 144 characters occur in ZH: 59 are ZH single-character names, 46 occur only inside ZH compound names, and the rest occur only on the declined list.
- 22 wenli characters occur nowhere in ZH (category W).
- Going the other way, 134 of ZH's 193 single-character names are absent from wenli.
- Of wenli's 66 registered expression and card labels (word-network.json), 6 equal ZH names: 中和, 刚柔, 变通, 和而不同, 生生, 约定俗成.

3. CONVERGENCE (judged)
- Of the 93 characters whose senses can be compared (S+O+D): 59 same (63%), 12 overlap (13%), 22 different (24%).
- Adding the 23 characters ZH declines gives 116 substantive characters: 87 agree (S+O+NC, 75%); 75 agree strictly (S+NC, 65%); 29 disagree (D+ND, 25%).
- By layer: core 113 = S49 O9 D20 NC9 ND6 W20; syntax 11 = S5 G6; extension 20 = S5 O3 D2 NC7 ND1 W2.
- Of the 6 shared compounds: 刚柔, 和而不同, 约定俗成 agree; 生生 and 变通 overlap; 中和 differs.
- Refusals: ZH declines 21 single characters. Wenli registers 13 of them (道气天人性德礼信义仁虚反易) and omits the other 8 entirely (心命诚智一多空蔽). Wenli gives those 13 characters 22 senses: Formula 7, InterpretationRecord 5, NormJudgement 4, ModelDeclaration 3, Program 3. Every sense of 道, 气 and 性 is an InterpretationRecord, and 仁 is normative only.

4. WHERE THE TWO CONVERGE
(a) Same defining passage, same structure:
- 化 and 续/实: 荀子正名 状变而实无别 / 有化而无别谓之一实. Wenli core.009 化 and core.019.01 实 against ZH 化 (Web.Continues) and 续.
- 体: 墨经 体分于兼. Both read it as part of a whole and both exclude 体用 (wenli core.036.01; ZH 體 note).
- 故: 墨经 小故 is a necessary condition, 大故 a necessary and sufficient one (wenli core.098.01–02; ZH 小故, 大故).
- 类: 墨辩 以类取，以类予. Inference needs a property-preserving bridge (wenli core.099.02); ZH has generalization exactly where the lumping determines (推类, Learning.determines_lumped_iff).
- 名/宜: 荀子 约定俗成. Renaming changes no world relation (wenli core.018.02 and core.101.01; ZH 名无固宜, SharedCodes.renamed_carries_iff at LEAN/SharedCodes.lean:735).
- 成/毁: 齐物论 其分也成也，其成也毁也. Wenli core.046.01 (?¬goal;a;?goal) and extension.07, against ZH 成 (ComesToBe) and 毁 (CeasesToBe).
- 复: 复卦. Return of a configuration, not of the same individual (core.055; ZH 復).
- 常: an invariant. Wenli core.088.01 is box(star(p), invariant) and says it does not guarantee an endless trajectory; ZH 常 is Invariant and is kept apart from 久.
- 势: 孙子. A configuration-determined reachability profile (core.061.01) against a basin (ZH 勢, HexagramLaws.lean:406 qian_basin).
- 几: 系辞 几者动之微. Both read an early signal (core.062.01; ZH 知几).
- 机: 孙子 节如发机. Both read a trigger point (core.063.01; ZH 機 juncture).
- 量: comparison only within one kind (core.065; ZH 量 citing 墨经 异类不吡).
- 和而不同: CX-level reading against Web.pool_adds and pooled_iff_member (LEAN/SelectionPool.lean).
- 息 split into growth and stopping: wenli core.081.01 (牛山) and core.081.02 (中庸) against ZH 消息 and 不息.
- 未 is not 不: wenli syntax.02 forbids reading "not yet" as "never"; ZH 凡·三 reads 未 the same way (Learning.no_prefix_fixes_next).
(b) Formal results reached independently:
- 久 in a complete finite model (wenli core.068.02): unbounded persistence holds exactly where a safe path as long as the number of states exists, that is, a safe cycle. This is the shape of LEAN/Onward.lean:164 run_iff_continues and :179 run_iff_returning (canonical §1.2 "Where a run goes on").
- Merging loses the old partition (CX05.R2), against Law.Merges.loses (LEAN/Recurrence.lean:693) and Law.lossless_iff_returns (§1.2).
- Response is not feedback, and feedback is not stability (CX02), against 应, 还 and 环 kept apart, and runaway loops (LoopReturn.runs_away).
- 自然 does not remove the need for inputs: CX10 "cannot delete Water", against Flow.new_beyond_every and fed_from_beyond (§1.3).
- 变 does not imply 通 (CX04), against "窮則變 is not a law" (§1.5) and the 定域 of 易穷则变 (CIVILIZATION §四·四 item 2).
- 相生: co-determination is not causation, and a directed cycle is not feedback (CX12), against ZH declining 五行 until it passes the 环 test (symbols-not-adopted.tsv, 五行).
- 序: neither project assumes a total or transitive order (core.008; ZH 序 note).
(c) Convergent refusals:
- 道: wenli core.003.01 says "no unified 道 operator"; ZH declines it (symbols-not-adopted.tsv).
- 气: interpretation only, against declined as a substrate.
- 性: two competing contexts kept, against declined as a fixed nature.
- 仁: normative only, against declined.
- 有/无: logical, not an ontological ground.
- 阴阳: a declared polarity, not physics; both use 刚柔 for line values.
- 五行: historical nodes, not a mechanism.
- 天: only 荀子 天行.
- 义: both separate "meaning" (wenli core.103.02 文义; ZH 义项) from the ethical sense.
- Neither derives 善 from the dynamics (wenli core.105; canonical §1.5 on 繼之者善).
- Wenli also anticipates two ZH gaps listed in CIVILIZATION §八. Evidence from one source must not be counted twice (core.095.01), which is gap 6. Multiple bases are conjunctive (CX07), which bears on gap 1.

5. HOW INDEPENDENT THE TWO PROJECTS ARE
Independence is only partial:
- Both use the same canon. Much of the agreement comes from definitional passages (墨经, 荀子正名) that themselves fix the sense.
- Wenli's 八卦 work used 《中华思想脉络》 (civilization-thought-v1.0) as a read-only reference (WL/13 §八; WL/11 opening; WL/18 §二), the same database ZH mapped and from which 246 ZH names take their quotations (CIVILIZATION §一, §五·三).
- Wenli's founding conversation already framed its programme by Ren's 生生不息论 (WL/02 第一轮).
- Both were built by AI.
- The formalisms are independent: PDL over finite multi-sorted models on wenli's side, the Lean spine on ours.
So the convergence shows that the texts constrain the readings strongly. It is not independent confirmation of the theory.

6. DISAGREEMENTS ONE BY ONE (W = wenli, Z = ZH; then the verdict on the texts and on the structure)
1. 系. W core.007.01: a typed relation, borrowed from 系辞, and WL/05 JY7 admits the borrowing. Z 繫辭: a frame, i.e. claims attached to configurations. Text favours Z: 系辞焉 means attaching statements to the figures. Structure favours Z: the core needs no separate relation primitive, because relata are relational (§0 block A, "One kind of relatum"). W needs 系 because its signatures are sorts plus typed relations.
2. 形. W core.015: shape, and disclosure to an observer (孙子). Z 有形: embodiment. Text favours W. On structure there is no conflict: Z's 状 covers W's shape.
3. 因. W core.026: acting according to conditions (因地, 因其固然). Z 因: inheritance (论语 殷因於夏禮). Both are attested, and W's is the dominant philosophical sense. Z's pairing with 损益 is tidy. W's sense corresponds to Z 应 / 缘感而择.
4. 承. W core.028: bearing and lineage (坤 顺承天). Z 承: the hexagram seam only. W is more general; Z is the 王弼 technical sense, kept to the 易 chapter.
5. 界. W core.040: membership boundary and allocation limit (荀子 度量分界). Z uses 界 only in 涸界 (threshold) and names the boundary 畛. W fits the text; no conflict.
6. 生 (the most important). W core.044: appearance of a kind, birth into a kind, producing successors, being alive. Z 生: generation as opposed to degeneration (widening). Arising is a separate name, 作; living is 活. Text favours W, which covers the attested range. Structure favours Z: the theory requires that generation and degeneration not overlap (AGENTS.md; canonical §1.3 Readings), and W's "any appearance" is exactly the reading the theory rules out, although W also refuses 生⇒善 (CX01 facts_vs_norms). The two are reconciled by a mapping: W 生-event to Z 作/成/新作; W 活着 to Z 活; W 产生后续实例 to Z 所出/出者. Z 生 has no W counterpart.
7. 开. W core.052.01: making a channel available (老子52 开其兑). Z 開: openness of the world (World.arising_opens), with no quotation recorded. Text favours W. Z's 闢 and 交 already cover W's sense.
8. 闭. W core.053.01: closing a channel (老子52). Z 閉: an absorbing region. Text favours W; Z is a principled dynamical extension. Both deny it a negative value.
9–10. 聚/散. W core.056–057: aggregation and disassembly (知北游). Z: coming to stand, and ceasing to stand, as a condition. W is closer to the text; Z's 结/解 carry W's sense. Both are workable.
11. 动. W core.058.01: displacement (墨经 動，或徙也). Z 動: a move, glossing 或徙 as "a possible shift" (names-decisions.tsv; ZH 一·三). Text favours W. In 墨经, 或 is used for 域: the same 經上 has "窮，或有前不容尺也" and 經下 has "宇或徙" (sources/civilization-thought-v1.0/evidence/additions/ming/MI1-S-JS.txt and MI1-S-JX.txt). So 動 is a change of region, and Z's gloss is weak. The name 動 for "move" stays apt; the gloss should be revised.
12. 往. W core.071: going, departing (日往月来). Z: the past course (彰往察来, 藏往). Both are attested; Z is the sense the core needs for knowing.
13. 亡. W core.076: exit from a kind in one event, which Z names 已. Z 亡: never active again (老子 死而不亡, Web.Ends). Z is better on text and on structure.
14. 中. W core.082 and CX03: affect not yet expressed, and timely appropriateness; W refuses the regulation and mean readings. Z 中和 / 中节: two-sided regulation (Becoming.Regulation). ZH 十二·十四 itself labels this correspondence 定域. Text favours W. Z's structure is sound, but the name carries an affective and normative context the law lacks.
15. 衡. W core.084.01: a standard of judgment (荀子解蔽). Z 衡: conservation balance (Flow.Balances), with no quotation recorded and with both the 墨经 lever and the 荀子 standard excluded (names-decisions.tsv note). Text favours W. Z's sense is central to the core and needs a cited source, for example the image of a balance at rest.
16. 节. W core.085: budget, rhythm, measure (节卦, 孙子). Z uses 节 only in 中节 and 环节. W fits the text; no conflict.
17. 正. W core.087: normative correctness and correction. Z 正: the hexagram's 正 position only. W has the primary sense; Z's is scoped.
18. 观. W core.091: an observation record (观乎天文以察时变). Z 觀: the view (process, frame, world); observation is 聞見. W is the plainer sense; Z's suits the core's "views of one unfolding" (§1.1).
19. 察. W core.095: examining several clues. Z 察: sensitivity, with no quotation recorded. Text favours W; Z stretches the character.
20. 明. W core.096: clear discernment (知常曰明, 大清明). Z 明: a coupling that reaches what support does not mark (论语 浸润之谮). W is closer to the plain sense; Z is a principled narrowing central to §7.
21. 宇. W extension.10: space (墨经 宇弥异所, paired with 久). Z 宇: the world, with space as 諸宇. Text favours W.
22. 游. W: practice (游于艺). Z uses 游 only in 下游. No conflict.
ND1. 易. W core.004: a transition family. Z declines it as polysemous, and reads 生生之谓易 as a scope (§1.5). W's own split into two senses confirms the polysemy. W's label "持续生成变化" mixes 生 into 变; W's recipe itself is neutral. W's structure equals Z's 變 (Generative.Process).
ND2. 德. W core.005: rearing and support (老子51 德畜之) plus a norm. Z declines it for its value layer. W's sense is attested; Z covers support with 与/容/持/恒. For a core whose definitions carry no weight, Z's refusal is safer.
ND3. 礼. W core.104: an institution and its practice. Z declines it, with 分 as its core. Both read 荀子礼论 as allocation: W core.032.03 against Z 分 (exclusive footprints, JointPlan.supports_of_realizes). Z for the core, W for applications.
ND4. 信. W core.097: reliability and trust. Z declines it; its structure is in 征/符. Z for the core.
ND5. 虚. W core.110: capacity and practice, explicitly not a void. Z declines it because of 太虚. Neither treats it as a substance; tie.
ND6. 反. W core.054: opposite direction, and returnable as ⟨program⟩origin. Z declines it, with the structure in 复/环. Both scope 反者道之动; the difference is in naming only.
ND7. 人. W extension.14: an Agent domain. Z declines it for the 天人 dualism (symbols-not-adopted.tsv). This is substantive. W's signatures presuppose Agent, Entity and Kind sorts (08 JSON semantic_contract.signature_types). The nondual method forbids an agent primitive (AGENTS.md; NONDUAL-METHOD "Formation, participation and responsibility"). Z is better for the core.
Notable overlaps:
- 理 (W core.002 against Z 理; ZH 七·二). The same passages: 解老 理者成物之文 and 庖丁 因其固然. W reads it as structure restricting admissible paths; Z as a lumping that carries the law (Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped). 解老 凡理者…之分也 supports Z's 理 as 分 (ZH 七·二). Z also has the theorem.
- 物 (W core.013 against Z 物 as relatum). Both deny a substance. W declares entities in sorted finite domains; Z has one kind of relatum with two roles. Z for the core.
- 法 (W core.100 against Z 法). W keeps 墨经 所若而然 as a standard and refuses the natural-law reading. Z marks its "law read off the history" as an AI extension. The extension fits 所若而然 structurally ("a history is a run of the least law it shows", §1.1). W is closer to the text.
- 生生 (CX01 against ZH 六·十六). Both say: generation whose products generate again, not one individual's survival, and not ⇒ good. Z adds that what is formed creates the conditions of later life, compared by widening (Web.Widens, AI reading D1). W's gen edges are any new instance (GenT(T) := Alive ∧ ⟨(gen;?Alive)^T⟩⊤). W is close to 孔疏 不絕之辭; Z is better for the structure.
- 积 (W extension.06, an accumulation process, against Z 積, a level that can fall). W's caveats about forgetting and saturation agree with Z's "积可降可涸".
- 感. W core.029 types it as a causal claim that needs evidence; Z defines it as a coupling inside the model. The structure is the same; the status differs.

7. WHAT EACH PROJECT HAS THAT THE OTHER LACKS
- ZH only (134 single-character names). These include the theory's specific relational content.
  - Clusters C02, C04, C05, C06 and C14 have 55 single-character names. Wenli has 11 of them (交绝积衡开衰量久续复生), and 衡, 开, 积 and 生 differ in sense.
  - Wenli has none of the C14 significance names: 顾活方我己萌尽别畛.
  - It lacks 待 (dependence), 资, 足/需, 容, 取/与/流, conservation, 耗/端 (dissipation, least loss), 恒/竭, 广/狭/益 (widening) and 顾 (significance).
- Wenli's semantics is finite: "有限多类对象与有限状态" (08 JSON semantic_contract.model), and finite domains cannot prove unboundedly many new instances (time_policy). So it cannot state the core's openness results (§1.3 "Openness", "Fed from beyond").
- Wenli only (22 characters): mostly social, normative and application words (治乱善觉…), plus 文 as its entry point.
- Wenli's strengths:
  - noncoercion typing that keeps Formula, Program, NormJudgement, Evidence and Interpretation apart (08 JSON semantic_contract.noncoercion);
  - per-sense sources;
  - glosses closer to the literal text in 12 of the 29 disagreements (形因界开闭聚散动衡节正察宇);
  - its own refusal to claim minimality or universality (WL/18 §一: "最低性与普遍性未证").

8. BEARING ON THE QUESTION "IS THIS THE BEST LANGUAGE FOR THE CORE?"
The convergence supports a narrower claim: classical Chinese characters give fitting names for the generic relational-dynamic layer of change, identity, return, invariance, reachability, classification, naming, conditions and the refusal of a prior ground. Two projects, built separately, chose the same senses from the same passages for about three-quarters of the shared characters.
It does not support the claim that 文理生生 is the most suitable language for the core:
- it is a typed interface grammar for any finite transition system, not a statement of this theory's laws;
- its signatures start from sorted entities and agents, with 系 as a relation primitive, where the core starts from one kind of relatum;
- it has no vocabulary for the core's dependence, flow, dissipation, widening and significance;
- its finite semantics excludes the openness results;
- it does not itself claim minimality or universality, and it declines 道 as an operator.
The language of the core remains ZH's anchored names. This comparison gives three concrete improvements:
- revise the glosses where wenli's textual reading is better (動's 或 as 域; citations for 衡, 開, 察);
- adopt wenli's fact/process/norm/evidence/interpretation typing and per-sense splitting as a convention layer;
- use wenli as a cross-check and as application vocabulary.
Ren's statement that it is the best language is provenance; per AGENTS.md "Ren's words are provenance", the reading has to stand by the argument above.

findings.point: Most shared characters converge: 75% of the 116 characters with comparable senses or refusals agree (65% strictly), 25% disagree.
findings.evidence: Script over WL/research/references/08_组合文法逐字类型词典_v0.3.json (144 characters, 245 senses) and ZHW/names-decisions.tsv (447 names, 193 single characters) plus ZHW/symbols-not-adopted.tsv. 122 of the 144 wenli characters occur in ZH. The judged categories: S59, O12, D22, NC16, ND7, G6, W22. Of the 93 comparable characters, 63% are the same, 13% overlap and 24% differ.
findings.bearing: Supports the narrower claim: classical characters fit the generic relational-dynamic layer, and two separately built projects pick the same senses. This alone does not show that 文理生生 is the core's language.

findings.point: Many agreements rest on the same defining passages, read the same way.
findings.evidence: 荀子正名 化 and 一实 (wenli core.009, core.019; ZH 化, 續). 墨经 体分于兼 (core.036; ZH 體). 小故 and 大故 (core.098; ZH 小故, 大故). 以类取以类予 (core.099; ZH 類, 推類). 约定俗成 (core.018/101; ZH 名無固宜, SharedCodes.renamed_carries_iff at LEAN/SharedCodes.lean:735). 齐物论 成毁 (core.046, extension.07; ZH 成, 毀). 复卦 (core.055; ZH 復). 知常 / 复命曰常 (core.088; ZH 常).
findings.bearing: The texts constrain the readings strongly, so the classical lexicon is a reliable carrier of these structures. Because definitional passages fix their own senses, this agreement is weaker evidence of independent insight.

findings.point: Wenli independently reaches several results that are already theorems on the spine.
findings.evidence: Wenli core.068.02 (久 in a complete finite model: a safe path of length N, i.e. a safe cycle) against LEAN/Onward.lean:164 run_iff_continues and :179 run_iff_returning. CX05.R2 (a merge loses the old partition) against LEAN/Recurrence.lean:693 Law.Merges.loses. CX02 (感应 does not imply feedback or stability) against 應, 還, 環 and LoopReturn.runs_away. CX10 (自然 still needs Water) against Flow.new_beyond_every. CX04 (变 does not imply 通) against canonical §1.5 '窮則變 is not a law'. syntax.02 (未 is not 不) against ZH 凡·三.
findings.bearing: The core's generic laws are what a careful reading of these characters yields under a different formalism, which counts in their favour. It also shows that wenli's grammar reproduces the generic layer, not the theory's specific laws.

findings.point: Both projects refuse the same non-relational layers.
findings.evidence: 道: wenli core.003.01 says 'no unified 道 operator' (InterpretationRecord only); ZH declines it (symbols-not-adopted.tsv). 气 and 性 are interpretation only in wenli and declined in ZH. 仁 is normative only. 有/无 are logical in both. 阴阳 and 五行 are historical declarations (extension.17–22). 天 is limited to 荀子 天行. Wenli omits entirely 8 of ZH's 21 declined single characters (心命诚智一多空蔽).
findings.bearing: This independently confirms ZH's declined list and CIVILIZATION §四·三 (the four non-relational layers). A core language built on these characters should keep 道 as a 号, not as an operator, which is also what wenli does.

findings.point: The two projects are only partly independent.
findings.evidence: WL/13 §八 and WL/11 opening: wenli's 八卦 work used civilization-thought-v1.0 (《中华思想脉络》) as a read-only reference, the same database CH/CIVILIZATION-THOUGHT-AND-BECOMING.md §一 maps and from which 246 ZH names take their quotations. WL/02 第一轮: the founding conversation already framed the programme by Ren's 生生不息论. Both projects use the same canon and were built by AI.
findings.bearing: The convergence shows that the readings are textually constrained. It is not independent confirmation of the theory or of the claim that the language is best.

findings.point: The central disagreement is 生. Wenli's 生 is any appearance, birth or being alive; ZH's 生 is generation opposed to degeneration (widening).
findings.evidence: Wenli core.044.01–04 and CX01 (GenT(T) := Alive ∧ ⟨(gen;?Alive)^T⟩⊤; gen edges are any new instance; 生⇒善 is refused). ZH 生: '生成（generation），与退化相对', with arising named 作 and living 活 (names-decisions.tsv); ZH 六·十六 生生 is 'compared by widening' (Web.Widens, AI reading D1). Canonical §1.3 Readings and AGENTS.md: generation and degeneration do not overlap.
findings.bearing: On text wenli is more faithful to the full range of 生. On structure the theory needs ZH's narrower notion, which wenli lacks entirely. A language for the core must keep ZH's 生 and map wenli's event senses to 作/成/新作, 活 and 所出.

findings.point: Wenli's ontology is many-sorted and starts from entities; the core starts from one unfolding with one kind of relatum.
findings.evidence: 08 JSON semantic_contract.signature_types: signatures take Entity, Kind, Agent and Time sorts. 系 (core.007.01) is a typed-relation primitive, borrowed from 系辞 (WL/05 JY7). 人 is an Agent domain (extension.14). Canonical §0 block A, 'One kind of relatum': formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum. ZH declines 人 (symbols-not-adopted.tsv). AGENTS.md: a closing remark does not fix an entities-first framing.
findings.bearing: This is the decisive structural reason that wenli is not the core's language: its type signatures presuppose what the core derives. For 系, 物 and 人, ZH's choices are the right ones for the core.

findings.point: Wenli lacks the theory's specific relational vocabulary, and its semantics is finite.
findings.evidence: Script: wenli has 11 of the 55 single-character names in ZH clusters C02, C04, C05, C06 and C14, and none of C14 (顾活方我己萌尽别畛). It has no 待, 资, 足/需, 容, 取/与/流, 耗/端, 恒/竭, 广/益. Its 衡 is a standard (core.084.01), not conservation. 08 JSON semantic_contract.model and time_policy: finite sorts and states, and no proof of unboundedly many new instances. Compare canonical §1.3 'Openness' and 'Fed from beyond'.
findings.bearing: Wenli cannot state the rest theorem, joint excess, widening or the continuation condition without importing ZH's names. As a language for the core it is incomplete.

findings.point: In 12 of the 29 disagreements, wenli's gloss is closer to the literal classical sense than ZH's.
findings.evidence: 动: 墨经 uses 或 for 域 (經上 '窮，或有前不容尺也'; 經下 '宇或徙', in sources/civilization-thought-v1.0/evidence/additions/ming/MI1-S-JS.txt and MI1-S-JX.txt), against ZH's gloss 'a possible shift' (names-decisions.tsv 動; ZH 一·三). 宇: space in wenli (extension.10), world in ZH. 开/闭: 老子52 channels (core.052–053), against ZH's openness and absorbing region. 衡: 荀子 standard, against ZH conservation, which has no quotation recorded. 察: examining clues, against ZH sensitivity, no quotation. Also 正, 因, 形, 界, 节, 聚/散.
findings.bearing: ZH's names are mostly structurally apt but sometimes stretch the characters. The best core language is ZH's revised at these points: correct the gloss of 動, and cite or reconsider 衡, 開, 察. Wenli shows where to revise.

findings.point: Where ZH's sense is better, it is better for the structure and sometimes for the text as well.
findings.evidence: 亡: 老子 死而不亡 supports ZH's 'never active again' (Web.Ends); wenli's 亡 is ZH's 已. 系辞 系辞焉 supports ZH's frame over wenli's typed relation. 往: 彰往察来 gives the past course the core needs for knowing. 理: 解老 '凡理者…之分也' supports ZH's 理 as 分 / lumping (ZH 七·二, Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped). 物 as relatum fits the relational start.
findings.bearing: The core's key names (亡, 系辞, 往, 理, 物) should stay as ZH defined them. Wenli's alternatives would weaken the relational start.

findings.point: Wenli's typing (noncoercion) is a strength that ZH does not formalize.
findings.evidence: 08 JSON semantic_contract.noncoercion: NormJudgement, TextClaim, Evidence, CausalClaim and InterpretationRecord are not Formula. Senses are split per character, each with its own source (08 md '怎样读这份词典'). Compare AGENTS.md 'hide no weight or obligation in a definition' and ZH's four statuses (无设而然, 有设而然, 设, 讀).
findings.bearing: Adopting this typing as a convention layer over ZH's names would make the value/fact separation visible at the level of each name. That is a concrete gain wenli offers the core language.

findings.point: Wenli anticipates two gaps that ZH lists as open.
findings.evidence: Wenli core.095.01 察: evidence from one source must not be counted twice, against CIVILIZATION §八 gap 6 (dependent witnesses add nothing). CX07 本末: multiple bases are conjunctive, against §八 gap 1 (a conjunctive whole).
findings.bearing: As a cross-check, wenli points to laws the spine has not yet proved. That is useful input for the gap programme (board item WH1), not a reason to replace ZH.

findings.point: Wenli does not itself claim to be minimal or universal.
findings.evidence: WL/18 §一: the minimal grammar for any system is '已构造受限候选；最低性与普遍性未证'. WL/03 §一: the 五元 has modern design components, and 文 is an entry point and organizing principle, not a derivation. WL/04 §十六: 互, 层, 限, 证, 坏 are modern technical labels.
findings.bearing: The claim that 文理生生 is the best language for the core goes beyond what wenli itself claims. Per AGENTS.md, Ren's statement is provenance and the reading must stand on argument. The argument supports ZH as the core language, with wenli as a complement.

findings.point: At the compound level: three of the six shared compounds agree, two overlap and one differs.
findings.evidence: Labels in WL/data/word-network.json equal to ZH names: 刚柔, 和而不同, 约定俗成 agree. 生生 overlaps (CX01 against ZH 六·十六) and so does 变通 (CX04 reconfigure;?CanReach against ZH Pace). 中和 differs: CX03 reads affect and norm, ZH reads two-sided regulation (Becoming.Regulation), and ZH 十二·十四 itself labels the 中庸 correspondence 定域.
findings.bearing: ZH's 中和 / 中节 names carry an affective and normative context the regulation law does not have. Keeping the name with its 定域 label is defensible, but wenli's text-faithful reading should be recorded as the historical sense.
